items.title: Ray Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, AZ, April 16, 2000
items.q: I’d stand out and listen to Jimmy Blanton play with Duke Ellington’s orchestra through the glass also.

ctx.x: So you didn’t mind selling newspapers in front of those churches then.

Oh no I wasn’t selling them in front of the churches. I had a fixed route. In other words I had customers. I mean I delivered papers to people. But these churches were on my route, there were a couple of them, and there were a couple of beer gardens where I’d stand out and listen to Jimmy Blanton play with Duke Ellington’s orchestra through the glass also.
That feeling of the church is not all that much removed from rhythm & blues is it?
